_note: Trimmed from the running server-health loop. Hostnames, IDs and paths replaced; structure and values otherwise as deployed.
title: Fleet health: zero red checks on both servers, one daily card, every repair gated
host_reasons: the health check reaches both servers over SSH; server keys never go to a cloud environment (policy)
the bot token used for the card lives in the local keychain and is read by name

goal.statement: Every day the health check (24 checks across both servers) reports zero red checks, and one decision card is posted by 10:45 local time with decisions listed apart from FYIs.

sub_goals.description: Freshness, not presence, on all four backup lanes; metric is the count of lanes outside their age threshold.

actions.notes: The only ungated action. The fingerprint is what stops a second card the same day.

forbidden_without_gate: restart (any container, service or daemon, on either host)
prune (image or system prune; volumes are never pruned, gate or no gate)
delete (files, dumps, backup objects, platform resources, messages)
a second card the same day (later runs add buttons to the existing card instead)
running the health check without --dry-run (it would post its own card)

stop.note: A day with zero red checks still posts the card: a silent monitor reads like a healthy fleet. Three days with the same red checks and no answered gate is an escalation, not a routine.
